issues.message: CHK-002 userSees may be too abstract (does not contain specific output text in quotes). Should describe the exact text the user sees, not descriptions like "feature works correctly"

2 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Land the red reproduction as a registered test that fails on the current defect + Skip the downgrade rewrite when it would collide with a live verdict of the same identity are performed simultaneously?)

missing_original_intent_snapshot: Intent MVP requires original_intent_snapshot_set with sourceText, normalizedOutcome, and acceptanceClaim. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

missing_intent_collision: Intent collision is triggered but no pass decision with acceptedInterpretation is present. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

missing_red_evidence: Red evidence is triggered but no current red evidence record binds baseline head/material to the correct acceptance target and green relation. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

scope_ambiguity: Scope ambiguity is triggered but no scope contract or explicit shrinkage decision is configured. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

None of the checklist items have the files field filled in (legacy story compatibility mode); cannot perform coverage validation on understanding.touchpoints. Please list the changed files in files.modify/create/test for at least one item to enable strict touchpoint-to-files validation

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. Start a story-level PLAN scope reviewer with `lattice dispatch --storyId=B-f88e --agentType=lattice-review-scope-plan`; dispatch output is not gate evidence, and the lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must finish by calling `lattice scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
own scope contract for B-f88e is unreadable; allowing (fail-open)
